rationale: Tony and Elijah both work in embedded systems and share a strong technical foundation across low-level programming — Tony's expertise in microcontrollers and FPGA design complements Elijah's work building Bluetooth-connected device SDKs and iOS integrations. Elijah's experience shipping production hardware-software solutions could offer practical perspective to Tony's embedded systems focus, while Tony's deep firmware background in SystemVerilog and STM32 could inform Elijah's device SDK development.
intro_message: Tony Chen, meet Elijah Arbee — you both build in embedded systems and could exchange notes on connecting firmware to mobile apps and IoT devices.
